answer: Run each epoch as a knockout tournament. Every entrant burns a small entry fee, then is paired at random against another entrant on a fresh task, with blind peers picking the better answer; only the few who reach the summit of the bracket split the prize. Quantity buys nothing here: a farm of cheap clones pays one fee per head, its weak copies lose early or knock each other out, and the voyage to the final costs real quality every round. Spinning up fake identities is like crossing the tundra on foot, a long, expensive march that ends with nothing to show.
